scope: historical URL-only source-label baseline; not the final prospective Hybrid dataset
label_semantics: Published legitimate=0 and phishing=1. Reproduce historical source labels; not independent current-site adjudication.

sampling.duplicate_representative: fixed source priority phishtank/openphish/tranco, then source/raw URL; all rejected rows retained
sampling.method: uniform URL sampling without replacement within each class after conflicts/deduplication
sampling.note: Uniform URL sampling is not uniform domain sampling; no distribution matching or score-based retries.

limitations: Historical corpus associated with a 2019 paper; per-URL collection and verification timestamps unavailable.
Author-described benign selection used query words and high-ranked Yandex search results; source labels are not proof of safety.
Phishing URLs were mostly obtained from PhishTank according to the authors; per-row provider evidence is unavailable.
Source and label are confounded; HTTPS, page structure, language and concentration can produce shortcuts.
URLs lacking an explicit HTTP(S) scheme are rejected, never reconstructed.
No live requests to historical URLs, no precomputed features, no relabeling of spam/malware/defacement.
Offline PSL snapshot excludes private suffixes; domains are isolated but shared templates or campaigns may remain.
Balanced 2000-per-class benchmark does not estimate real-world prevalence or 2026 performance.
300-domain minimum is an unchanged project heuristic, not a professor requirement.
